summary.title: Feature Flags, Toggles, Controls – The Hub for Feature Flag Driven Development
summary.one_liner: A LaunchDarkly-powered hub of guides on feature flag driven development, covering use cases, code patterns, flags versus branching, blue-green deployments, and database migrations.
keywords: how to implement feature flags in an app
takeaways: Feature flags can decouple deploys from releases to reduce risk, as covered in the best practices section.
Feature flags are compared with feature branching, and used for blue-green deployments and database migrations.
Guides cover avoiding technical debt from leftover flags through code patterns.
Example implementations include React with Redux Saga, Angular e-commerce, and scheduling flag updates with deploys.
LaunchDarkly offers client and server-side SDKs for many platforms (page claims 25+).
summary.summary: This is a hub site from LaunchDarkly that organizes material on feature flag driven development into topics: benefits and use cases, getting started, code patterns and technical debt, best practices, flags versus branching, blue-green deployments, database migrations, and implementation. It also lists key literature, including a 2018 LaunchDarkly getting-started guide and 2017 articles on React, Angular, and scheduling flag updates with deploys. The page is mostly a table of contents with short descriptions, plus a promotion for LaunchDarkly SDKs and an O'Reilly eBook, so the detailed content lives on the linked subpages.
